lake_queries.name: filing_samples
lake_queries.query:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) AS lo, CAST(? AS DATE) AS hi),
u AS (SELECT 'insider' AS dataset,accession,filingDate,periodOfReport,availableAt,availabilitySource,formType AS submissionType,CASE WHEN formType LIKE '%/A' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isAmendment,dateOfOriginalSubmission AS original_date,issuerCik AS entity_cik,resolvedTicker AS ticker,NULL::VARCHAR AS amendmentType,sourceUrl FROM lake.insider_filings,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND filingDate <= hi AND (periodOfReport IS NULL OR periodOfReport <= hi) AND (dateOfOriginalSubmission IS NULL OR dateOfOriginalSubmission <= hi)
UNION ALL SELECT 'institutional',accession,filingDate,periodOfReport,availableAt,availabilitySource,submissionType,isAmendment,NULL::DATE,cik,NULL::VARCHAR,amendmentType,sourceUrl FROM lake.institutional_filings,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND filingDate <= hi AND (periodOfReport IS NULL OR periodOfReport <= hi)),
r AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY dataset,EXTRACT(YEAR FROM availableAt),isAmendment ORDER BY accession,ticker) AS n FROM u)
SELECT * EXCLUDE(n) FROM r WHERE n <= 3 ORDER BY dataset,availableAt,accession

lake_queries.name: filing_timing
lake_queries.query:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) AS lo, CAST(? AS DATE) AS hi),
u AS (SELECT 'insider' AS dataset, accession, filingDate, periodOfReport, availableAt, availabilitySource, CASE WHEN formType LIKE '%/A' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS amended, dateOfOriginalSubmission AS original_date FROM lake.insider_filings,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND filingDate <= hi AND (periodOfReport IS NULL OR periodOfReport <= hi) AND (dateOfOriginalSubmission IS NULL OR dateOfOriginalSubmission <= hi)
UNION ALL SELECT 'institutional',accession,filingDate,periodOfReport,availableAt,availabilitySource,isAmendment,NULL::DATE FROM lake.institutional_filings,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND filingDate <= hi AND (periodOfReport IS NULL OR periodOfReport <= hi))
SELECT dataset,EXTRACT(YEAR FROM availableAt) AS year,amended,availabilitySource,COUNT(*) AS owner_or_filing_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT accession) AS distinct_filings,MEDIAN(DATE_DIFF('day',periodOfReport,filingDate)) AS median_report_delay_days,QUANTILE_CONT(DATE_DIFF('day',periodOfReport,filingDate),0.95) AS p95_report_delay_days,MIN(DATE_DIFF('day',periodOfReport,filingDate)) AS min_report_delay_days,MAX(DATE_DIFF('day',periodOfReport,filingDate)) AS max_report_delay_days,SUM(CASE WHEN periodOfReport > CAST(availableAt AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS report_after_available,MIN(CAST(availableAt AS DATE)) AS min_date,MAX(CAST(availableAt AS DATE)) AS max_date FROM u GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

lake_queries.name: joint_coverage
lake_queries.query:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) AS lo, CAST(? AS DATE) AS hi),
p AS (SELECT o.ticker,s.security_id,CAST(o.date AS DATE) AS day,o.closingPrice,o.unadjustedClose,o.volume,o.marketCap,o.sharesAvailableAt FROM lake.sec_daily_ohlc o JOIN lake.security_segments s ON o.ticker=s.ticker AND CAST(o.date AS DATE) BETWEEN s.from_date AND COALESCE(s.to_date,DATE '2020-12-31'),bounds WHERE CAST(o.date AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND s.from_date<=hi AND s.asset_type='CS'),
w AS (SELECT *,COUNT(CASE WHEN closingPrice > 0 THEN 1 END) OVER(PARTITION BY security_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 252 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prior_price_bars,COUNT(CASE WHEN volume IS NOT NULL AND volume >= 0 AND unadjustedClose > 0 THEN 1 END) OVER(PARTITION BY security_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prior_volume_bars,AVG(unadjustedClose*volume) OVER(PARTITION BY security_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS proposed_adv FROM p),
snap AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY security_id,EXTRACT(YEAR FROM day),EXTRACT(MONTH FROM day) ORDER BY day DESC) AS n FROM w),
i AS (SELECT DISTINCT resolvedTicker AS ticker,CAST(availableAt AS DATE) AS available_day FROM lake.insider_transactions,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND resolvedTicker IS NOT NULL AND transactionCode='P' AND acquiredDisposed='A' AND (transactionDate IS NULL OR transactionDate <= hi)),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT resolvedTicker AS ticker,CAST(availableAt AS DATE) AS available_day FROM lake.institutional_holdings,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND resolvedTicker IS NOT NULL AND sharesType='SH' AND (putCall IS NULL OR putCall='') AND sharesAmount > 0),
joined AS (SELECT s.*,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM i WHERE i.ticker=s.ticker AND i.available_day<s.day AND i.available_day>=s.day-INTERVAL 90 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS insider_record,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM h WHERE h.ticker=s.ticker AND h.available_day<s.day AND h.available_day>=s.day-INTERVAL 365 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS institutional_record FROM snap s WHERE n=1),
eligible AS (SELECT *,closingPrice >= 5 AND prior_price_bars=252 AND prior_volume_bars=20 AND proposed_adv >= 10000000 AS proposed_price_liquid FROM joined)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM day) AS year,EXTRACT(MONTH FROM day) AS month,COUNT(*) AS observed_tickers,SUM(CASE WHEN prior_price_bars=252 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sufficient_252_bars,SUM(CASE WHEN prior_volume_bars=20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sufficient_volume,SUM(CASE WHEN proposed_price_liquid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proposed_price_liquid_tickers,SUM(CASE WHEN proposed_price_liquid AND marketCap >= 1000000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cap_threshold_tickers,SUM(CASE WHEN proposed_price_liquid AND marketCap >= 1000000000 AND sharesAvailableAt IS NOT NULL AND CAST(sharesAvailableAt AS DATE)<day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cap_lineage_tickers,SUM(CASE WHEN proposed_price_liquid AND insider_record=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS insider_positive_presence,SUM(CASE WHEN proposed_price_liquid AND institutional_record=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS institutional_presence,SUM(CASE WHEN proposed_price_liquid AND insider_record=1 AND institutional_record=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joint_positive_presence,MIN(day) AS min_date,MAX(day) AS max_date FROM eligible GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

joined AS (SELECT s.*,CASE WHEN i.available_day>=s.day-INTERVAL 90 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS insider_record,CASE WHEN h.available_day>=s.day-INTERVAL 365 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS institutional_record FROM (SELECT * FROM snap WHERE n=1) s ASOF LEFT JOIN i ON s.ticker=i.ticker AND s.day>i.available_day ASOF LEFT JOIN h ON s.ticker=h.ticker AND s.day>h.available_day),
